target_customer: Consumers and creators making and sharing short looped videos; advertisers
problem: Let people remix existing video and audio into looping clips up to 10 seconds with sound.

founders.name: Anton Gladkoborodov
founders.background_notes: Reported to have left after Komitet took full control.

founders.name: Mikhail Tabunov
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder on Wikipedia only.

exit.reason: Acquired by Komitet in 2020 per press; shutdown announced 2022 then reversed under new owners

competitors.name: Vine
competitors.what: Six second looping videos recorded by users

technical_complexity.rationale: Video looping and audio mixing at scale with tens of millions of monthly visitors.

defensibility.rationale: Remix focus and community differed from Vine but clones were easy; no strong lock in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Short video platforms grew far larger; Coub was sold to Komitet in 2020.

market_need_then: YC described Vine as record your own video while Coub let users remix existing video and audio; Coub claimed 51M monthly unique visitors.

branding.community_and_virality: Press called the format viral; Know Your Meme covered the 2022 shutdown plan.

brand_strength.rationale: Recognized meme style loop brand in Russian speaking internet; evidence is press coverage, not brand pages.

outcome_analysis: Coub started in 2012, raised about $3.5M across 2013 and 2014, joined YC in Summer 2016 and reported 51M monthly visitors. Komitet bought it in early 2020, announced a shutdown in March 2022 after failing to sell it, then a new team kept it running. Why it stalled commercially is not stated by sources, so the failure factors are weak inference.
notes: YC status Inactive but Wikipedia says it has run under a Swiss based private company since April 2022 and the Archive Team wiki says it was still online in June 2025; current status unconfirmed. Total raised $3.5M (ZoomInfo) or $3.62M (CB Insights). Lead of the 2014 round named as Vaizra Investments only by ZoomInfo, unverified. The 2016 YC deal is not a round. Name origin unverified blog claim of cube not used. Exit typed unknown because YC says Inactive while press shows a 2020 acquisition by Komitet and a reversed 2022 shutdown.
